title: Crossplay Gameplay Intent Boundary
rules: same gameplay intent vocabulary for Android/iOS/Windows/macOS
touch/mouse/keyboard/gamepad translate into the same gameplay intents
camera and HUD presentation are never server-authoritative gameplay
no platform-specific combat damage, movement speed, cooldown or reward rules
future multiplayer transport must validate gameplay intents server-side
M82 does not create accounts, sockets, matchmaking or server authority

future_server_boundary.server_owns: movement validation, combat resolution, inventory, rewards, progression, persistence
future_server_boundary.client_owns: input translation, camera, responsive HUD, local accessibility/presentation
